items.title: General Mills Announces Three-Segment Operating Structure Effective January 2027
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) announced plans to reorganise its operations into three business segments beginning January 1, 2027, as part of changes to its management structure and commercial operations. The Minneapolis-based food manufacturer will operate through Cereal, Snacks & International; Meals & Baking Solutions; and Pet.
